messages:
incidents-bot: Pager — elevated 5xx rate on /v2/generate (canary routing: v2). SLO breach, 18% error rate over 2m. auto-rollback policy eligible. https://runbooks/internal/rollbacks :rotating_light:

sarah: I’m paged, looking at canary pods now. which customers hit?

mike: I see spike coinciding with v2 rollout (traffic 22% to canary). logs show OOMs and request timeouts on gpt-attention module. attaching short logs: `OOM at step kv_alloc`

raj: can we flip the feature flag for rollout_v2 to off? we should try kill-switch first.

sarah: flipping flag rollout_v2 -> off (console). will post confirmation. :warning:

incidents-bot: Flag toggle recorded by sarah at 1779998904. Traffic target set back to v1 immediate for new sessions.

dana: draining canary pool now via infra: `infra drain --pool canary-v2 --grace 30s` — starting eviction.

mike: note: controller auto-rollback also started but stalled on a few stuck instances (eviction failing due to long-lived requests).

jess: starting manual eviction of stuck pods, `kubectl delete pod` on the three stuck IDs. also clearing local KV cache on those hosts: `systemctl restart kv-cache`.

mike: manual rollback in progress (controller fallback + flag flip). pushing previous image tag v1.34 to canary nodes.

incidents-bot: Automated rollback job triggered at 1779998918 (policy: error-rate > 10% for 2m). status: in_progress, blocked_by: 3 stuck pods.

raj: customer-impact note: enterprise customers A & C saw elevated latencies and some 504s during peak (window ~ 1779998880–1779998910). estimated 3% of total requests affected. ops->support notified.

support-bot: Notifying #support with draft message: "We observed a transient error spike during a rollout; engineers reverted the rollout and are verifying system stability. We'll follow up with root cause."

sarah: eviction finished, pods replaced, traffic now shifting fully back to v1. Monitoring graph trending to baseline.

jess: running smoke tests: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` -> OK, and sample generation run (100 qps for 30s) -> error rate 0.7%.

mike: running deeper verification: headroom and memory profiles look normal. KV cache restarts removed OOM patterns.

raj: next steps: leave rollout_v2 flag off, block any automated re-rollouts for 1h, create a rollback-incident ticket and assign to eng-runtime for root cause.

sarah: created INC-177999 ontracker with timeline, added screenshots and logs. setting severity to Sev2 and tagging PM and Solutions.

jess: post-rollback checklist: 1) confirm no enterprise retries left, 2) collect traces for 10m span, 3) snapshot canary artifacts for debugging. I'll own the trace collection.

mike: agree. also add a follow-up action to run the kv allocation stress test against v2 in staging with memory limits.

incidents-bot: Incident transitioning to monitoring at 1779998956. No active SLO violation for last 3m.

sarah: moving to postmortem, oncall handoff to mike for 1h watch. tagging #postmortems and scheduling quick sync with runtime team in 30m. :white_check_mark:

jess: note for postmortem — safe rollout automation allowed both flag flip and auto-rollback; we need clearer ordering in runbook when both fire simultaneously.

mike: copying that into the postmortem doc. closing thread here, will follow up with timeline and RCA draft. :lock:
